name: Bright Cow 83
author: NouvelleTechno
description: Outlined rounded red card that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, text color changes from #009c00 to #ffffff, background-color changes from hsl(120deg 20% 95%) to #ff0000, box-shadow becomes 4px 4px 8px 0px #867c7c, 
    inset -8px -8px 16px 0px #861414, 
    inset 0px 14px 28px 0px hsl(120deg 20% 95%).
